title: power-set-game-3
input: First line contains T, denoting the number of testcases. Each test case contains N, the size of set S.
output: Print in one line for each testcase, the required answer modulo 10^9 + 7.
standard_solution_code:
t=int(eval(input()))
mod=1000000007
while(t>0):
	n=int(eval(input()))
	ans=(pow(4,n,mod)-pow(2,n,mod)+mod)%mod
	print(ans)
	t-=1
